summary: Comprehensive backend + smoke frontend testing for Contractor OS. Backend: 12/13 pytest tests passed (100% functional; the 1 failure was my own test-case casing assertion since backend intentionally lowercases emails). Frontend: login + all 4 tabs (Dashboard/CRM/Quotes/Jobs) load and navigate correctly on 390x844 mobile viewport with no red-screen errors.

issues: Deprecation console warnings: 'shadow*' style props (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents' (use style.pointerEvents) — non-breaking but should be cleaned up

action_items: Add testID attributes to interactive elements: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit, register-toggle, tab-dashboard, tab-crm, tab-quotes, tab-jobs, fab-add-lead, fab-add-quote, quote-line-add, quote-save, lead-status-advance, job-progress-plus, job-progress-minus, job-add-note. Currently tests rely on placeholder/text selectors which are fragile.
Cleanup React Native deprecation warnings (shadow* → boxShadow, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents).
Optional: fix my test casing assumption (backend correctly lowercases emails on register/login; that behavior is fine, my assert was wrong).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 867 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, crm, quotes, jobs, pricing) for maintainability (>700 line threshold).
GET /api/pricing-rates uses $or on company_id which is correct for global+tenant merging; verified filtering by trade works.
convert-to-job correctly blocks non-ACCEPTED and prevents duplicate jobs per quote (verified).
Multi-tenant isolation is uniformly enforced via list_docs/get_doc filters on company_id (verified via 2-company test).
Password reset endpoint returns the reset_token in the response — fine for dev/testing, but for production ensure it is emailed only (not returned in JSON).

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 real; 1 self-test bug not app bug)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed customers/leads/quotes/jobs and register 2 fresh companies + EMPLOYEE + VIEWER users each run. Not cleaned up (soft-delete only via app). Consider a cleanup fixture later.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) in frontend/.env — read that env var. Login credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md work: jane@acme.com.au / pass123. Password reset endpoint returns reset_token in JSON body (dev-mode). Global seeded pricing rates have company_id=null and are visible to all tenants (intentional). 35 Victoria rates seeded. Calculation formula: direct + overhead% → subtotal → profit% → pre_gst → gst% (10%) → final_total. Verified: 50m2*$120 + 10hr*$350 = 9500 direct → 950 overhead → 1567.5 profit → 1201.75 GST → 13219.25 final.
